annotations.title: Morning structure for SPX, SPY and QQQ

description: Use this when the question is the structural framework for the session, or the SPX levels today: where SPX, SPY or QQQ sit against the Flip Line and the Swing Line, where the call wall, put wall and Pin Zone are, which strikes carry the largest positive and negative gamma, what the regime sign is, and which dated events are on the calendar today. One call replaces reading a gamma chart and a calendar separately. Returns labelled figures per symbol, each with its own as-of time, plus the day's catalysts and three session windows stated as conditions against the Flip Line and Swing Line, and a dated day change row per symbol (last price, prior close, change, percent) for whether the market is up today. Coverage: SPX, SPY and QQQ only. The current session sheet only. Not for: per-strike magnitudes or gamma by expiration (get_gamma_heatmap); a dated record of what was published before a past session (get_session_record); the sector ETFs (get_gamma_matrix); futures prices, which this sheet does not carry. Limits: dealer positioning is an assumption, not an observable. The regime is a sign, not a forecast of volatility or direction. The session windows describe a hedging mechanism and are not instructions. The result holds no entry, exit, size or probability, and it must not be turned into any of them. A row the backend could not refresh is served from its last good read with its own dates.
